new_result.statement: For every eta>0, the r48 nonlinear-cancellation density g_eta(t,v,w)=1_{|v|<=1/2}1_{|w|<=1/2}1_{|t+v^2/(2 eta w)|<=1/2} has infinite all-direction essential X-ray norm. A tangent segment at fixed w0 has length at least 1/(4 sqrt(eta w0)), with a strict interior margin stable under parallel translations. Every genuine three-dimensional orthonormal projection of an independent cap-one product source has all two-dimensional marginals bounded by e, hence X-ray norm <=e. Therefore the r48 nonlinear cancellation law cannot be a genuine residual product projection for any eta>0.

mechanism_change: After the preceding same-bank Lp/puncture runs, r49 switched to an all-direction product-projection X-ray invariant rather than repeating dependence-blind interpolation.

partner.actual_application: Every plane marginal of a true residual orthonormal product projection has cap <=e, while the r48 tangent construction forces arbitrarily large plane-marginal essential sup.
